description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate bone wasteland props arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each centered in its own cell, in this exact order left to right, top to bottom: giant white beast ribcage half buried; huge horned beast skull; small scattered pile of bones; dead gray tree stump; cluster of pale bleached white rocks; tattered red war banner on a wooden pole; rusty broken sword stuck in the ground; wooden spike barricade of sharpened stakes; totem pole topped with skulls, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no ground, no shadow puddles, no text, no characters
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, warm saturated palette, front-facing view. Do not draw this tree.
